title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Corrected Claim Reference: Authorization Denials and Retroactive Authorizations
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — authorization corrections (CO-197).** An authorization denial is cured by an authorization correction where the order carries an approved authorization with its authorization number, the plan having accepted the provider's retroactive request. An authorization correction answers the claim's most recent authorization denial with the order's approved authorization and carries the denied amount being resubmitted, as the company's rule for authorization corrections fixes it. The resubmission on the claim history is the observable result.

## Capability

`file_authorization_correction_79145f91` records one corrected-claim resubmission carrying the retroactive authorization, dated today, on the claim ledger of the coverage holding the claim, under the original claim number, linked to the authorization denial line it answers and carrying the amount put back in front of the plan. Nothing else on the coverage or the claim changes.

## Invocation

The tool belongs to the agent: unlock `file_authorization_correction_79145f91`, then call it.

## Parameters

1. `coverage_id` — the coverage holding the claim, as returned by the coverage lookup. Id.
2. `customer_id` — the patient's customer reference number, as returned by the customer lookup. Id.
3. `claim_number` — laboratory claim number of the claim being corrected: 'C' followed by 10 digits, exactly as shown on the claim history.
4. `order_id` — the order the corrected claim bills, as shown on the claim history line. Id.
5. `source_claim_event_id` — the authorization denial line the corrected claim answers, as returned by the claim-history lookup. Id.
6. `rebill_amount` — amount the corrected claim puts back in front of the plan: USD with 2 decimal places, a non-negative number rounded half up to the cent.

## Return

A text receipt: `claim_event_id` is the reference number of the new resubmission; `event_type` `coverage_claim_resubmitted` and `resubmission_reason` `corrected_claim` confirm a corrected claim was recorded; `claim_number` echoes the claim corrected; `amount` is the amount put back, USD with 2 decimal places; `event_date` is today's date as YYYY-MM-DD. A receipt carrying a `claim_event_id` means the corrected claim was recorded.

## Points on the cure

- The cure rests on the order: an approved authorization, with its authorization number, carried on the order the claim bills.
- The corrected claim stays under the original claim number and answers the authorization denial line it is linked to.
